subject: Cherry Hills Village gets heat for its e-bike ban on popular High Line Canal trail
posts:
An affluent town's e-bike ban sparks friction over senior trail access.

Cherry Hills Village e-bike ban
Evidence: safety policy, senior mobility loss, rigid municipal rules
#Aletheia #Colorado

Seniors argue e-bike bans deny pain-free exercise on the popular High Line Canal trail, limiting active outdoor recreation for aging residents.
Stated Judgement: (+1.00, +1.00) — Good Preference

City officials enforce a blanket motorized ban for trail safety, creating a disconnect with neighboring jurisdictions where e-bikes are fully allowed.
Resulting Judgement: (+0.10, +0.60) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: COND — The Path of Deception. Municipal risk aversion clashes with legitimate senior mobility needs, creating an arbitrary trail exclusion.

- Cherry Hills Village: COND (-0.6, -0.7) — Prioritizes blanket safety rules.

Cherry Hills Village bans e-bikes on its stretch of the High Line Canal trail, even though neighboring cities allow them, frustrating seniors who rely on pedal-assist for exercise.

The Bright Side:
The city maintains consistent multi-use safety rules for horses, pedestrians, and cyclists without high-speed throttle friction.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The conflict mixes WHAT (trail access rules) with WHO (seniors vs trail management). The rule applies a blanket prohibition without weighing individual mobility needs.

Social Physics Analysis:
By enforcing a rigid blanket ban rather than engaging with modern mobility needs, the city relies on pretexts of safety while ignoring the exclusionary impact on older residents.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated safety intentions and exclusionary results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil.

The Unavoidable Truth: Blanket municipal rules can inadvertently penalize seniors seeking low-impact exercise.

The Unavoidable Lie: Total e-bike bans are the only way to keep multi-use trails safe.

Alethekanon:
Rigid bureaucratic uniformity trumps adaptive common sense, punishing seniors for technological change. 🌐
